name: mirage
text: I checked the list GitHub is publishing right now. SX Bet's odds are in none of the 25 listed bets. SX does feed in: about 8 to 10 games with lines in your leagues, and a trusted exchange price on 8 of them. That is thin next to Pinnacle's or FanDuel's coverage, so SX rarely shows up in a bet's fair price. I can't yet tell you whether that is thin SX coverage or a failure to match its lines. Version 1.0.73 will settle it: each scan note will count how many lines SX, Kalshi and Polymarket priced. It will also list any book whose prices sit far from the others' on the same line, which is the sign of a wrong match. I'm building it now and will release as soon as it passes the tests.
